verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with scoped API keys, so a downloadable API spec is a fair thing to ask for, but nothing in the evidence shows it publishes an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on all of them. The llms.txt file that does exist is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit here.
